messages:
mia-sales: Heads-up — Asterion (large healthcare customer) just asked for an executive bridge. CISO wants BYO KMS + a dedicated network peering path. They also asked for an updated POC cost estimate if we add guaranteed throughput. Need a one-pager of blockers before the 1pm PT sync.
raj-se: Can you drop the exact asks? BYO KMS + peering + throughput guarantee — do they want SLA numbers or just an architecture sketch?
tom-eng: From infra POV: peering + BYO KMS is doable but needs 2 things: 1) IP allowlist + BGP peering runbook; 2) KMS attestation plan (HSM or external?) — timeline ~3 business days for configs.
zoe-legal: We need to know whether customer will require an audit contract addendum for key custody. If BYO KMS means customer holds keys, legal needs the SKUs and op model to update the DPA.
elena-cs: I can own the POC runbook and demo slots. Suggest we offer 2 options: (A) Fast path: host keys with our KMS + peering (48h), (B) BYO KMS + peering (5 business days + legal). Provide pricing delta for both.
mia-sales: Good. Also finance flagged that Asterion asked for a 20% pilot discount if we commit to dedicated capacity. Can we get a quick cost delta for reserved pool vs on-demand?
raj-se: Quick note — reserved capacity pricing depends on GPU class and min throughput. I'll pull a ballpark: reserved is ~40% cheaper for steady load >100 rps. I'll add that to one-pager.
tom-eng: For the exec bridge, ops needs these artifacts: network diagram (peering + CIDRs), KMS integration plan (flow diagram), and failover policy if peered link degrades. I'll sketch diagrams.
zoe-legal: Also attach the security questionnaire excerpt they flagged: sections on key control, export of logs, and customer-managed keys. I'll annotate which points need contract updates.
elena-cs: I'll run a quick internal trial with sample data to verify latency under guaranteed throughput — capture token-level billing impact.
ops-bot: Calendar: Exec bridge with Asterion scheduled 2026-04-02 13:00 PT — meeting link created. Participants: mia-sales, raj-se, tom-eng, zoe-legal, elena-cs, asterion-ciso.
mia-sales: Plan: I'll send the one-pager to the bridge channel by 11:30 PT. Raj/Tom/Elena/Zoë — please annotate your sections in the doc by 11:00 so I can iterate. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
raj-se: On it. Will include reserved vs burst pricing examples and a short note on rollback to hosted model.
tom-eng: Adding a short command snippet for peering verification that we can hand them:
```
# sample: verify BGP sessions
show bgp summary | include asterion
ping 10.20.30.1 source 10.20.30.2
```
zoe-legal: I'll flag the contract items inline and mark anything that requires exec approval.
elena-cs: I'll have demo telemetry and a slide with expected token cost delta.
mia-sales: Thanks all — keep replies here. If anything slips, call me.
